requirement_vague: Updating a todo with mismatched ID returns bad request
requirement_precise: Register a user and login. Create a todo (returns ID=X). Call PUT /todos/X with a request body where id=Y (different from X). Verify the response status is 400 Bad Request.

omissions.description: PUT /todos/{id} does not reject a request body whose id differs from the path id with 400 Bad Request.
omissions.reasoning: The update_todo route accepts TodoUpdate with an optional body field id, but it never compares todo_in.id to the path parameter id. It proceeds to update the todo after only checking existence/ownership, so a mismatched body id is ignored instead of causing a 400 response as required.
